sets.name: Rag Set
sets.desc: Barely covers you, but it's better than nothing. Your first day in Valheim.

sets.name: Leather Set
sets.desc: Your first real armor. Hunt deer, craft this, stop dying so fast.

sets.name: Troll Set
sets.desc: Kill trolls in the Black Forest. Shockingly good — sneak bonus makes it a ranger's dream.
sets.bonus: +25% Sneak — essential for bow users and stealth builds.

sets.name: Bear Set
sets.desc: New in the Call to Arms update. Made from bears in the Black Forest. Between Troll and Bronze in defense — but the Berserk set bonus makes it a unique aggressive playstyle. Bears flee from torches.
sets.bonus: Berserk: +30% health regen · +15% stamina regen · +10% slash damage · +10% chop — but -25% physical resistance. High risk, high regen.

pieces.name: Patterns of the Bear
pieces.recipe: 5 Bear Hide + 2 Bear Paw + 4 Blueberries → Workbench

sets.totalMats: 15 Bear Hide, 4 Bear Paw, 4 Blueberries, 1 Bear Trophy (min 4 bear kills)

sets.name: Bronze Set
sets.desc: First metal armor. Heavier than troll but more raw protection for melee fighters.

sets.name: Iron Set
sets.desc: The workhorse set. Farm iron from sunken crypts, survive the swamp, wear this into the mountain.

sets.name: Root Set
sets.desc: Bow users only. Woven from ancient roots, it grants a massive ranged damage bonus.
sets.bonus: +15% Ranged damage — must-have for bow builds throughout mid-game.

sets.name: Wolf Set
sets.desc: Built-in frost resistance — the only way to survive the mountain without chugging potions.
sets.bonus: Frost resistance built-in. No potion needed while wearing the full set.

pieces.name: Drake Helmet
pieces.recipe: 20 Silver + 2 Wolf Pelt + 2 Drake Trophy → Forge

pieces.name: Wolf Hide Trousers
pieces.recipe: 20 Silver + 5 Wolf Pelt + 4 Wolf Fang → Forge

sets.totalMats: 60 Silver, 12 Wolf Pelt, 4 Wolf Fang, 2 Drake Trophy, 1 Chain

sets.name: Fenris Set
sets.desc: Secret berserker set from Frost Caves in the Mountains. Uses Fenris Hair dropped by Fenrings (the werewolf enemies, not Bears). Highest mobility armor in the game.
sets.bonus: +9% movement speed · Fire & frost resistance · +15 Unarmed skill. Pairs with Flesh Rippers for a full berserker build.

pieces.name: Fenris Hood
pieces.recipe: 20 Fenris Hair + 2 Wolf Pelt + 1 Cultist Trophy → Workbench lv2

pieces.name: Fenris Coat
pieces.recipe: 20 Fenris Hair + 4 Wolf Pelt + 10 Leather Scraps → Workbench lv2

pieces.name: Fenris Leggings
pieces.recipe: 20 Fenris Hair + 4 Wolf Pelt + 10 Leather Scraps → Workbench lv2

sets.totalMats: 60 Fenris Hair, 10 Wolf Pelt, 20 Leather Scraps, 1 Cultist Trophy

sets.name: Padded Set
sets.desc: The strongest non-Mistlands armor. Needs swamp iron to make plains-tier gear.
sets.bonus: No set bonus — just raw, excellent defense.

sets.name: Carapace Set
sets.desc: Made from seeker shells. Heavy, tough, built for Mistlands dungeons.

sets.name: Eitr-weave Set
sets.desc: For magic builds only. Boosts eitr regeneration significantly.

pieces.name: Eitr-weave Hood
pieces.recipe: 10 Linen Thread + 5 Refined Eitr + 3 Blue Jute → Black Forge

pieces.name: Eitr-weave Robe
pieces.recipe: 20 Linen Thread + 10 Refined Eitr + 5 Blue Jute → Black Forge

pieces.name: Eitr-weave Trousers
pieces.recipe: 20 Linen Thread + 10 Refined Eitr + 5 Blue Jute → Black Forge

sets.totalMats: 50 Linen Thread, 25 Refined Eitr, 13 Blue Jute

sets.name: Flametal Set
sets.desc: Endgame warrior armor. Massive defense, fire resistance built in.
sets.bonus: Fire resistance built-in. Essential for surviving the Ashlands.

pieces.name: Flametal Breastplate
pieces.recipe: 30 Flametal + 10 CharredBone + 5 Molten Core → Forge of Ancients

pieces.name: Flametal Greaves
pieces.recipe: 30 Flametal + 10 CharredBone + 5 Molten Core → Forge of Ancients

sets.name: Set of Ask
sets.desc: Lighter Ashlands armor from Asksvin hides. For those who prefer mobility.
sets.bonus: Higher movement speed than Flametal set.

pieces.name: Hood of Ask
pieces.recipe: 15 Flametal + 6 Scale Hide → Forge of Ancients

pieces.name: Breastplate of Ask
pieces.recipe: 20 Flametal + 8 Scale Hide + 5 Ceramic Plate → Forge of Ancients

pieces.name: Trousers of Ask
pieces.recipe: 20 Flametal + 8 Scale Hide + 5 Ceramic Plate → Forge of Ancients
